definitions.explanation: A feeling of unhappiness or displeasure about something; grumbling.

examples.japanese: {待遇|たいぐう}に{不平|ふへい}を{言|い}う。
{不平|ふへい}{不満|ふまん}を{持|も}たずに{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: To work without complaints or dissatisfaction.
examples.notes: 不平不満 = complaints and dissatisfaction

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{不平|ふへい}ばかり{聞|き}かされる。
examples.english: I keep having to listen to his complaints.

notes:
USAGE: {不平|ふへい} often appears with {不満|ふまん} in the set phrase {不平|ふへい}{不満|ふまん}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{不平|ふへい}を{言|い}う (to complain)
・{不平|ふへい}を{漏|も}らす (to grumble)
・{不平|ふへい}{不満|ふまん} (complaints and dissatisfaction)
・{不平|ふへい}なく (without complaint)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{不満|ふまん} - dissatisfaction (internal feeling)
・{苦情|くじょう} - complaint (formal, to authority)
・{文句|もんく} - complaint (casual, verbal)
